P52B-COMP-E-002.commonError: Using the everyday meaning of rivalry instead of the market structure.

P52B-COMP-M-001.commonError: Treating any chosen price as market power.

P52B-COMP-M-002.commonError: Overstating the influence of one small firm.

P52B-COMP-M-004.commonError: Ignoring how entry responds to profit opportunities.

P52B-COMP-H-001.commonError: Treating market structures as all-or-nothing labels.

P52B-COMP-H-002.commonError: Assuming a small firm can raise price without losing demand.

P52B-COMP-H-003.commonError: Ignoring how entry barriers protect incumbents.

P52B-COMP-H-004.commonError: Assuming seller count alone determines competitiveness.

P52B-COMP-EL-001.commonError: Using temporary profit as conclusive evidence of market power.

P52B-COMP-EL-002.commonError: Equating legal permission to enter with practical competitive viability.

P52B-COMP-L-001.commonError: Listing many traders without explaining why individual price control is limited.

P52B-COMP-L-002.commonError: Counting labels instead of economic control.

P52B-COMP-L-003.commonError: Reversing the effect of easier switching.

P52B-COMP-B1-001.commonError: Misidentifying the conditions that limit market power.

P52B-COMP-B1-002.commonError: Misidentifying the conditions that limit market power.

P52B-COMP-B1-003.commonError: Misidentifying the conditions that limit market power.

P52B-COMP-R-001.commonError: Confusing price taking with having no choice to participate.

P52B-COMP-R-002.commonError: Reversing the effects of entry and switching costs.

P52B-COMP-BR-001.commonError: Failing to apply competition logic to digital markets.

P52B-S3-DEM-B3-002.commonError: Claiming certainty when opposing demand shifters act simultaneously.

P52B-S3-DEM-B3-003.commonError: Calling an own-price movement a change in demand.

P52B-S2-SUP-E-001.commonError: Confusing market supply with one firm’s supply or with demand.

P52B-S2-SUP-M-001.commonError: Treating a producer subsidy as a movement along supply or a demand shifter.

P52B-S2-SUP-EL-001.commonError: Assuming one opposing supply shifter automatically dominates the other.

P52B-S2-SUP-EL-002.commonError: Ignoring an offsetting change in the number of sellers or input costs.

P52B-S2-SUP-EL-003.commonError: Calling a price-induced movement along supply an increase in supply.

P52B-S2-SUP-L-001.commonError: Using the largest or average firm quantity instead of summing quantities.

P52B-S2-SUP-L-002.commonError: Forgetting that market supply depends on the number of active sellers.

P52B-S2-SUP-L-003.commonError: Treating unequal per-unit cost changes as if they cancel.

P52B-S2-SUP-L-004.commonError: Applying future price expectations in the wrong time direction.

P52B-S2-SUP-L-005.commonError: Treating immediate output response and later firm entry as the same kind of change.

P52B-S2-SUP-L-006.commonError: Using the higher equilibrium price as evidence of an increase in supply.

P52B-S2-SUP-B1-001.commonError: Averaging firm quantities instead of adding them.

P52B-S2-SUP-B1-002.commonError: Calling a movement caused by the good’s own price a supply shift.

P52B-S2-SUP-B1-003.commonError: Confusing lower production cost with a movement along supply.

P52B-S2-SUP-B3-001.commonError: Assuming the label of a policy matters more than its net marginal-cost effect.

P52B-S2-SUP-B3-002.commonError: Failing to remove the exiting firm’s quantity from market supply.

P52B-S2-SUP-B3-003.commonError: Declaring a net shift when opposing determinants are not quantified.

P52B-S3-MEQ-E-001.commonError: Defining equilibrium as a shortage, surplus, or unrelated quantities.

P52B-S3-MEQ-B1-002.commonError: Reversing the price adjustment associated with a surplus.

P52B-S3-MEQ-B1-003.commonError: Using the supply-shift outcome for a demand increase.

P52B-S3-MEQ-B3-001.commonError: Claiming certainty about quantity when the two shifts move quantity in opposite directions.

P52B-S3-MEQ-B3-002.commonError: Claiming certainty about price when both curves shift left.

P52B-S3-MEQ-B3-003.commonError: Treating a surplus as a shortage or confusing movement along curves with shifts.

P52B-S3-MEQ-R-001.commonError: Reversing shortage and surplus or treating disequilibrium as a curve shift.

P52B-PSIG-E-001.commonError: Reading a higher price as a signal to reduce supply in all cases.

P52B-PSIG-M-001.commonError: Reversing buyer and seller responses to a higher price.

P52B-PSIG-M-002.commonError: Treating any lower price as evidence of lower demand.

P52B-PSIG-M-003.commonError: Ignoring the coordinating information contained in an allowed price increase.

P52B-PSIG-M-004.commonError: Treating profit only as a reward rather than an allocation signal.

P52B-PSIG-H-001.commonError: Inferring a unique cause from the direction of price alone.

P52B-PSIG-H-002.commonError: Equating the consumer price with the full social cost.

P52B-PSIG-EL-001.commonError: Confusing an equilibrium movement with movement along one curve.

P52B-PSIG-EL-002.commonError: Treating value to consumers as sufficient without comparing cost.

P52B-PSIG-L-002.commonError: Ignoring rationing mechanisms that emerge when prices cannot adjust.

P52B-PSIG-L-003.commonError: Treating corrective pricing as arbitrary punishment.

P52B-PSIG-B3-001.commonError: Misreading what prices, profits, or losses communicate.

P52B-PSIG-B3-002.commonError: Misreading what prices, profits, or losses communicate.

P52B-PSIG-B3-003.commonError: Misreading what prices, profits, or losses communicate.

P52B-PSIG-R-001.commonError: Reversing the buyer response to a higher price.

P52B-PSIG-R-002.commonError: Reversing the seller response to a higher price.

P52B-PSIG-BR-001.commonError: Failing to recognize nonmoney signals that coordinate scarce capacity.
